AUTH-02.note: Server sign-up and login work and are tested. Email verification and the app screens are missing.

AUTH-06.note: Name, username and country are stored. Photo, language and the app screen are missing.

AUTH-08.note: The server deletes the account and anonymizes its plays (tested). No button in the app yet.

AUTH-11.note: Terms and privacy consent are saved with version and time at sign-up (tested).

AUTH-12.note: Several devices can be signed in at once. Syncing library and settings is not built.

ART-01.note: The server upgrade step works and is tested. The app has no upgrade screen yet.

ART-02.note: Top-bar switch between the listener tabs and the artist tabs.

ART-03.note: Stage name, bio and type are stored. Photo, banner, genres and links are missing.

ART-04.note: Solo, group, producer/DJ and label/manager are stored and checked. No app screen yet.

ART-05.note: The declaration and its time are stored (tested). The app screen that shows it is missing.

ART-06.note: The agreement version is recorded. The agreement text and sign-off screen are missing.

ART-08.note: Stage names must be unique in any letter case (tested). Similar-name checks and reporting are missing.

ART-09.note: Artists use the same app and library. Using their listening for recommendations is not built.

ART-11.note: Every artist has a verified flag. The review process is missing.

STU-03.note: Title, genre and length are stored for a song (tested). The other details are missing.

LIB-01.note: Scans the Music and Download folders (Android), the Music folder (desktop) and any folder you add; only changed files are re-read. Automatic background rescans are missing.

LIB-02.note: mp3, m4a, aac, flac, wav, ogg, opus and aiff files are picked up.

LIB-03.note: Tags are read. Cover art is not.

LIB-04.note: Songs, Albums and Artists views. Genres and folders are missing.

LIB-05.note: Folders can be added and removed, and clips under 30 seconds are skipped. Excluding a folder has no screen yet.

LIB-07.note: Hearts and a Liked tab for songs on this device. Online songs are not covered yet.

LIB-16.note: Pick songs with the system picker; on phones they are copied into the app.

LIB-17.note: Scanning runs in the background with a live count.

SRC-06.note: The mix engine never blends YouTube or license-restricted tracks (tests written). YouTube playback itself is not built.

PLY-01.note: Play, pause, seek, next, previous and repeat. Shuffle is missing.

PLY-02.note: Notification, lock screen and headset buttons on Android, iOS and macOS.

PLY-03.note: The queue works inside the player. There is no queue screen (reorder, remove, history).

PLY-04.note: Mini player and full Now Playing screen. Swipe gestures are missing.

PLY-05.note: The audio session is set up for music so calls and other apps are handled by the system. Not tested on a phone.

PLY-06.note: Headset and Bluetooth buttons go through the system media controls.

PLY-20.note: Same work as PLY-02: background playback with system controls on Android, iOS and macOS.

MIX-01.note: Equal-power blend from 1 to 12 seconds (Normal mode is the off setting).

MIX-07.note: Songs on this device are blended. Downloaded online songs do not exist yet.

MIX-08.note: Songs marked not mixable, and YouTube songs, change with a clean cut (tests written).

MIX-21.note: Normal and Mixing modes on the player screen.

MIX-22.note: Separate blend lengths for end of song and for next/back.

MIX-23.note: Back restarts the song after 3 seconds, otherwise goes to the earlier song.

DSC-01.note: Search covers songs on this device only.

REC-02.note: The server accepts and stores plays safely (tested). The app does not send plays yet.

SOC-04.note: Server follow and unfollow for artists (tested). No app screen.

UIX-01.note: Midnight, Daylight, AMOLED black and follow-system. The choice is not saved between launches yet.

UIX-07.note: Aurora, Sunset, Forest and Ocean accents.

UIX-12.note: Empty and loading states exist for the Library and statistics, not everywhere.

STA-01.note: Plays, listeners, followers and saves with date ranges (server tested, screen built on demo numbers). Playlist adds are missing.

STA-02.note: Finish rate and skip rate per song. Replays and average listen time are missing.

STA-03.note: Countries only. Cities, age bands and devices are missing.

STA-04.note: Search, recommendations, playlists, charts, shares, library and direct (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

STA-07.note: Which songs yours are blended with (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

STA-08.note: Last 48 hours hour by hour (shown at any time, not only after a release).

STA-10.note: Groups with fewer than 5 listeners are folded into Other (tested).

STA-11.note: The 30-second stream rule is built and tested. Fraud filtering is missing.

STA-14.note: Server numbers for monthly listeners and followers (tested). No artist page screen.

STA-16.note: Every headline number shows its change against the period before (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

STA-17.note: Retention curve per song (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

STA-18.note: New, returning and super listeners (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

STA-20.note: Plays by hour for the last 48 hours.

PRF-01.note: Header with name and username. No photo yet; shows a placeholder name until login is connected.

PRF-02.note: 4 weeks, 6 months, this year, all time (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

PRF-03.note: Minutes listened with hours (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

PRF-04.note: Listening streak in the listener's own time zone (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

PRF-05.note: Top artists, songs and genres (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

PRF-06.note: Listening clock and personality (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

PRF-07.note: Songs blended and new artists found (server tested, screen on demo numbers).

PRF-08.note: The switch exists but is not saved or enforced yet.

PAY-02.note: Paywall flags exist on the server and default to off. The app does not read them yet.

BKE-01.note: Versioned /v1 API. Rate limits on sign-in only.

BKE-02.note: PostgreSQL holds users, artists, songs, follows, saves and plays. Playlists and a separate analytics store are missing.

BKE-13.note: A flags table and a read endpoint. No admin screen to change them.

BKE-15.note: Plays are stored straight into the database. No queue or stream yet.

QUA-03.note: FLAC and ALAC files are accepted and played by the platform players. Bit-perfect output is not handled.

DEV-01.note: One shared Flutter codebase. A custom native audio engine is not built.

DEV-03.note: The setup script adds the Android service and permissions and the iOS background mode. Battery-optimization handling is missing.

DEV-12.note: setup.sh builds Android, iOS, Windows and macOS from one codebase.

SAF-05.note: Account deletion works on the server. Data export is missing.

SAF-06.note: Passwords are hashed with scrypt. Encryption in transit comes with deployment.

SAF-12.note: Rate limits on sign-in. Nothing for uploads yet.

NFR-10.note: The server has 27 passing tests and the platform script 6. The Flutter tests are written but not run yet.
